title: Manual alarm via a button
body_md: In the operating mode provided for it, a voltage on pin 3 produces a manual alarm; the source also calls it a panic alarm. This can be done with a button, for example.
source_region: Section 1.3, function on the manual alarm
prev_context: Before this stands the control of the alarm system by call.
next_context: The table of operating modes follows on the next page.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 9: equivalent in substance. Neither version names a minimum duration, a voltage threshold or debouncing for the button; that gap remains.
